entities.summary: Travis Hamonic is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Detroit Red Wings of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 53rd overall by the New York Islanders in the 2008 NHL entry draft. He also previously played for the Calgary Flames, Vancouver Canucks and the Ottawa Senators.
